hooks.name: Reuse check before new module
hooks.description: Before creating (just creating) a new Python file, checks the module index for existing similar functionality that could be reused or extended instead of creating new code.

action.prompt: BEFORE creating this file: If this is a NEW .py file (not editing an existing one), verify against the module-index.md steering file that no existing module already provides similar functionality. If a match exists, state which module could be reused/extended and prefer that approach. If no match or the file is an edit to an existing file, proceed normally.
